Read Nightingale Data (format 2)

read_nightingale_v2.Rd

Read Nightingale Data (format 2)

Usage

read_nightingale_v2(filepath)

Arguments

filepath

character, commercial Nightingale excel sheet with extension .xls or .xlsx

Value

list, list(data = 3D matrix, samples = samples data.table, features = features data.table)

Examples

filepath <- system.file("extdata", "nightingale_v2_example.xlsx", package = "metaboprep2")
read_nightingale_v2(filepath)
